# Camden Pet Hospital

> > Full-service veterinary hospital in San Jose, California providing comprehensive care for dogs and cats in Silicon Valley.

Camden Pet Hospital offers a complete range of veterinary services including wellness exams, surgery, dental care, parasite prevention, and online booking through PetDesk. Led by Dr. Jelena and staff including Kerri Quezada and Gabriella Vischer, the hospital serves pets throughout the San Jose and Silicon Valley area.
